controllers.line: CPS Diesel generators are controlled by the worldwide renowned brand Deep Sea Electronics, manufactured here in the UK and providing customers worldwide pre/after-sales support. We use the DSE4520, DSE7120, DSE7420, and DSE8610 across our range of Diesel generators. Our engineers are fully trained to program and set up the parameters of the Deep Sea Electronics modules.
